# PTE Meal Plan

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A weekly meal plan built in Plan to Eat (PTE); a recipe, meal-planning, and shopping list subscription service.

## Scope note

Working meal plan assembled from DMP and other imported recipes; generates the weekly shopping list and syncs into the PKM Meals SwiftData database, as well as Neo4j graph database and Obsidian notes.
